profile.summary: Phoenix International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in leasing building properties in India. The company operates in two segments, Shoe Uppers Manufacturing and Rental Services of Immovable Properties. It manufactures and supplies shoe upper products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.
